nodes.description: FactRegistry mapping (bytes32 => bool) of registered/verified fact hashes.
FactRegistry boolean flag indicating at least one fact has been registered.
Public entry point of MerkleStatementContract; validates a merkle queue/view in assembly and registers the resulting fact hash.
Internal FactRegistry function that writes verifiedFact[factHash] = true and flips anyFactRegistered.
External view function of FactRegistry returning whether a fact was verified; delegates to _factCheck.
Internal view lookup into the local verifiedFact mapping.
External view function returning the anyFactRegistered flag.
Internal view Merkle decommitment verifier operating on raw memory pointers, hashes pairs and asserts hash == root.
Internal pure function returning the hash mask used to truncate keccak256 results.
Inline assembly in MerkleVerifier.verify performing unchecked mstore/mload, div/addmod arithmetic and keccak256 over raw memory.
Inline assembly in verifyMerkle copying user-controlled arrays to memory, computing pointers and free-memory pointer without bounds enforcement.
Unchecked assembly addition idxLowerLimit := add(curIdx, 1) on user supplied leaf indices.
Unchecked assembly shifts shl(height, 1) / shl(height, 2) used to derive index bounds from the height argument.
Assembly keccak256 over the copied queue data plus the resulting root that produces the registered fact hash.
uint256[] merkleView: proof nodes supplied by the caller.
uint256[] initialMerkleQueue: caller supplied leaf index/value pairs.
uint256 height: tree height used to derive index bounds (required < 200).
uint256 expectedRoot: root the verification must match.
uint256 channelPtr: pointer to the proof pointer in memory.
uint256 queuePtr: pointer to the merkle queue in memory.
bytes32 root: expected root compared against the computed hash in verify.
uint256 n: number of merkle queries to verify (<= MAX_N_MERKLE_VERIFIER_QUERIES).
bytes32 fact: queried fact hash in isValid/_factCheck.
bytes32 factHash: key written into the registry by registerFact.
Local nQueries derived from initialMerkleQueue.length / 2.
Local badInput accumulator OR-ing index validation failures.
Local factHash computed by keccak256 in assembly and registered.
Local resRoot returned by verify and appended to the hashed buffer.
Local lhashMask from getHashMask applied to keccak256 results in verify.

edges.reason: merkleView proof array is read and consumed by verifyMerkle's assembly.
initialMerkleQueue supplies the leaf index/hash pairs that verifyMerkle copies and validates.
height drives the shifted index bound computations shl(height,1) and shl(height,2).
expectedRoot is the target root the caller expects to be proven.
expectedRoot is forwarded as the root argument of MerkleVerifier.verify.
channelPtr points to the proof data consumed inside verify.
queuePtr points to the merkle queue consumed inside verify.
root is compared against the locally computed hash at the end of verify.
n bounds the number of Merkle queries iterated in verify.
fact is the queried key passed into the fact lookup.
fact is used as the mapping key read in _factCheck.
factHash is the key written into the verifiedFact mapping.
badInput accumulates index validation errors and gates the verification via require.
nQueries derived from the queue length drives the copy loop and verification.
nQueries is passed as the n argument to verify.
the assembly computed factHash is registered as a verified fact.
factHash is produced by the keccak256 assembly computation.
resRoot is appended to the data buffer before hashing to build the fact hash.
lhashMask masks the keccak256 result inside verify's assembly.
verifyMerkle executes the inline assembly block that copies and validates the queue.
verifyMerkle performs unchecked assembly addition on user supplied leaf indices.
verifyMerkle performs unchecked assembly shifts to derive index bounds from height.
verifyMerkle calls MerkleVerifier.verify with the prepared memory pointers.
the public verifyMerkle function registers a fact with no caller authentication or access restriction.
verify runs the inline assembly that hashes pairs and manipulates raw memory.
verify calls getHashMask to obtain the truncation mask.
isValid delegates its check to _factCheck.
_factCheck reads from the verifiedFact mapping.
registerFact writes verifiedFact[factHash] = true.
registerFact updates the anyFactRegistered flag on first registration.
hasRegisteredFact returns the anyFactRegistered state variable.
verify returns the computed root hash which is stored in resRoot.
verifyMerkle computes the fact hash with keccak256 inside assembly.
the computed fact hash flows into registerFact as the stored key.
the assembly block in verifyMerkle builds the dataToHash buffer consumed by the keccak256 hash.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller supplied proof array is fully consumed by verifyMerkle; keep it as an attribute of the function.
Queue parameter is only used inside verifyMerkle's validation and copy loop.
height only feeds the bounds arithmetic inside verifyMerkle.
expectedRoot is a call argument of verifyMerkle forwarded to verify; fold into the entry function.
Raw memory pointer used exclusively by verify.
Raw memory pointer used exclusively by verify.
root is only compared to the computed hash inside verify.
n only bounds the iteration count inside verify.
fact is the lookup key of the isValid external view function.
factHash is the sole key written by registerFact.
Derived local count controlling the loop; merge into the enclosing function.
Validation accumulator local; merge into verifyMerkle's control flow.
Locally computed value that is immediately registered by registerFact.
resRoot is only used as input to the keccak256 fact-hash computation.
Mask local obtained from getHashMask and applied inside verify's assembly.
